name: Indulge // Excess
oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control attacks this turn, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Aftermath (Cast this spell only from your graveyard. Then exile it.)
Create a Treasure token for each creature you controlled that dealt combat damage to a player this turn.
blocked_sentences: Create a Treasure token for each creature you controlled that dealt combat damage to a player this turn.

needs.what: a value counting the distinct creatures controlled by a given player (at the time they dealt it) that dealt combat damage to a player this turn, including creatures that have since left the battlefield -- e.g. {"creatures_dealt_combat_damage_to_player_this_turn": "you"} -- read off the turn ledger that already records players_dealt_combat_damage_by per source
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has no such tally; the turn ledger's players_dealt_combat_damage_by is exposed only through the player-selector key dealt_combat_damage_by (which seats were hit) and the combat_damage_by condition (a subtype check), neither of which counts creatures. A count over a battlefield selector has no 'dealt combat damage this turn' key (damaged/damaged_by read damage received), and would miss creatures that dealt damage and then left, which 'you controlled' explicitly includes
